Customization Studio

Design gaming banners, logos, YouTube thumbnails, overlays and team posters in your browser. Start from a template, edit, and export PNG or JPG.

Frequently asked questions

What can I export from the Studio?

PNG and JPG at the exact canvas size shown in the editor, with an optional transparent background for PNG. Projects can be saved to your account and edited later.

Do I need to install anything?

No. The editor runs in your browser, including on tablets and phones, and keyboard shortcuts such as undo (Ctrl+Z) work on desktop.
